bends.note: slants SSE (dx/dy ~0.25) from Lakewood to here, then runs due south to St Clair

notes: Printed names: 'W. NIXON', 'LAKEWOOD AV. (GREENWOOD)', 'W. ST. CLAIR', 'JEFFERSON AV.' (diagonal), 'GLENDORA ... AV.', 'VINE', 'FOUNTAIN', 'POWHATAN', 'GRAEFF', 'VOSS ALLEY', 'FLAKE' (stub label south of St Clair; same street as FALKE on 264/266, written with the 266 name); suffix-less names written with 'Street'. Jefferson Av (60 ft) is the long diagonal from the top-left to St Clair; Lakewood ends at its west side (T). At St Clair the diagonal meets ~545 px east of the N-S Jefferson leg that continues south on 266 (labelled 'JEFFERSON AV.' there too); the diagonal's St Clair crossing is written 'Jefferson Avenue (north of St. Clair)' as on 266, its other crossings plain 'Jefferson Avenue'. Nixon is ~40 ft just east of Jefferson and 60 ft further east (60' printed near Vine); west of Jefferson its kerbs curve off the left edge toward 267, so Jefferson/Nixon is a crossing (centre from the dashed main and the kerbs, +/-15 px). Glendora and Vine continue north across Nixon onto 270. East of Vine is 'See Volume Four'. Scioto (stub south of St Clair at the left edge, x~225) and Fountain, Powhatan, Graeff, Jefferson, Falke are the same crossings picked on 266 (sheet-to-sheet offsets ~25-70 px).
